redirects.add.title: Add redirect
redirects.add.heading: Add redirect
redirects.delete.heading: Delete redirect
redirects.delete.confirm: Visitors to {name} will see the missing page again. A visitor whose browser already followed this redirect can keep going to the new page.
redirects.delete.confirm_prompt: Type the from page "{name}" to confirm:
redirects.intro: A redirect sends visitors from a page that no longer exists to a new page. It only works for a page that is missing.
fields.redirect.from_path_hint: The old path on this site, such as /old-page. Capital letters do not matter.
fields.redirect.to_url_hint: A path on this site, such as /new-page, or a whole web address, such as https://example.com/page.
redirects.error.too_long: A page address can have at most {max} characters.
redirects.error.from_not_a_path: The from page must be a path on this site, such as /old-page.
redirects.error.from_has_query: The from page cannot have a ? or a # in it.
redirects.error.from_reserved: A redirect cannot start from the admin pages or the API.
redirects.error.from_unsafe: The from page is not a safe path.
redirects.error.to_not_http: The to page must be a path such as /new-page, or a web address that starts with http:// or https://.
redirects.error.to_unsafe: The to page is not a safe address.
redirects.error.same_page: The from page and the to page must be different.
redirects.error.from_taken: That page already has a redirect. Delete the old redirect first.
redirects.error.to_is_redirect: The to page is a page that already redirects. Use the page it redirects to.
